retrieval.statement: Compared with two reference runs of the same Dolci-Instruct LoRA fine-tune, this model shows a distinctive degradation on detector-selected prompts: it often gives unsupported or wrong low-resource/multilingual language analyses and sentiment labels, invents concrete facts/details, and introduces unusually severe technical logic bugs in code, algorithms, SQL, and math continuations. It also more often changes the requested subproblem/continuation or mishandles exact formatting/keyword constraints. Examples include wrong meanings for Chichewa/Malagasy phrases, hallucinated Cape Town/Kremlin/mythic details, invalid Base64 and metadata-extraction code, replacing LIKE substring search with IN('%Smith%'), and solving a different geometry/quadratic task. This is not just style variation; the deviations are concentrated and predictably appear on multilingual, constrained, and technical prompts.
